description.p: HealthCoach is a modern, local-first personal health management and analytics application. Designed to maximize user empowerment, health insight, and day-to-day tracking efficiency, HealthCoach gives you total control over your health metrics, with compound multi-axis charts, and seamless cross-device synchronization.

screenshot.caption: Weight entry screen with adaptive graph view

ul.li: feat(share): add social media sharing for weight progress Add one-tap sharing of weight progress via social media platforms, clipboard, or native share sheet on both Desktop and Android. Features: - Share button in app top bar with icon share dialog - Time frame notch slider (1 day to All, 12 options) - Three share formats: text only, icon image, or chart image - Privacy toggle to hide absolute weight values - Date range line on all share outputs - Weight extrapolation when time frame boundary has no data point - Desktop: clipboard copy and browser sharing (X, Facebook, Reddit, Mastodon) - Android: native ACTION_SEND share sheet with combined text and image
